# KloudAudit

> Free, self-guided cloud cost and security audit for AWS, GCP, Azure, and AI API spend (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock, Vertex). Users answer a structured checklist from their own knowledge — no cloud credentials, IAM roles, or account access are ever requested or required. The tool returns a Waste Score and a prioritised, estimated savings range in about 15 minutes. Paid one-time add-ons (Cost Blueprint, Security Blueprint, AI Blueprint, CFO & Board Report) deliver an AI-generated remediation guide with exact CLI commands, Terraform snippets, and an implementation roadmap for the issues flagged in a completed audit.

KloudAudit is built and operated by Samuel Ayodele Adomeh, a DevOps/Azure engineer based in Wrocław, Poland.
